definitions.explanation: The continent of South America, comprising twelve independent countries and several territories. In Japanese, commonly referred to in both full and abbreviated forms.

examples.japanese: {南|みなみ}アメリカ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}きたい→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I want to go to South America.

examples.japanese: {南|みなみ}アメリカ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{熱帯|ねったい}→熱帯：03531_nettai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{森|もり}→森：02260_mori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっている→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: Tropical forests spread across South America.

examples.japanese: {南|みなみ}アメリカ{大陸|たいりく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{最|もっと}も→最も：01736_mottomo⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{山脈|さんみゃく}→山脈：07856_sanmyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The South American continent has the longest mountain range in the world.

notes:
Written either as {南|みなみ}アメリカ or ⟦{南米|なんべい}→南米：04285_nanbei⟧. The full form is used in everyday conversation, while ⟦{南米|なんべい}→南米：04285_nanbei⟧ is the Sino-Japanese abbreviation preferred in news reports, formal writing, and compound terms.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {南|みなみ}アメリカ{大陸|たいりく}: the South American continent
- {南|みなみ}アメリカ⟦{諸国|しょこく}→諸国：15992_shokoku⟧: South American countries
- {南|みなみ}アメリカ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧: travel to South America

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{南米|なんべい}→南米：04285_nanbei⟧: South America — Sino-Japanese abbreviation; more compact and formal
- ⟦{北|きた}アメリカ→北アメリカ：26752_kitaamerika⟧: North America — the northern counterpart
- ⟦{中南米|ちゅうなんべい}→中南米：19053_chuunanbei⟧: Central and South America — often grouped together in Japanese media
